description.value: NoodleBox is a Canadian fast-food franchise chain serving customizable Asian-inspired noodle and rice bowls wok-fired to order, with a menu spanning teriyaki, pad thai, kung pao, curry, and more. The Langley Bypass location is part of a nationally operating franchise with dozens of locations across BC and beyond. Dishes can be modified to accommodate vegan and gluten-friendly dietary needs, making it broadly accessible for cyclists with varied requirements.
